"""Generate a deterministic six-stroke brush trajectory for the frozen 風 instance."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,time
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

PIX=.22185986964255727

def tip_path(p):
    u=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]
    t=np.linspace(0,u[-1],max(3,int(u[-1]/.4)))
    curve=CubicSpline(u,p[:,:2],bc_type='natural')
    xy=curve(t);tang=curve(t,1);tang/=np.linalg.norm(tang,axis=1)[:,None]
    width=np.clip(PchipInterpolator(u,p[:,2])(t),0,78.9)
    z=(width*PIX+.3)/1.187
    z[0]=.01;z[-1]=.01
    off=np.maximum(0,11.15-9.67*(z/10-1.091)**2)/PIX
    tip=xy+off[:,None]*tang
    return np.c_[tip,z]

def generate(pathfile='/app/output/best.npz',out='/app/output/trajectory.npz'):
    paths=[v for v in np.load(pathfile).values()]
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.065],speed=.12)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.04,settle=4)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.065],speed=.07,settle=3)
    for i,path in enumerate(paths):
        tip=tip_path(path)
        x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(tip[:,0],tip[:,1]);pos=np.c_[x,y,.020-tip[:,2]/1000]
        # An approach along the stroke tangent initializes the gathered hairs.
        v=pos[1]-pos[0];v[2]=0;v=v/np.linalg.norm(v)*.006
        start=pos[0].copy();start[2]=.030
        p['move_tip'](start-v,speed=.10,settle=3)
        p['move_tip'](start,speed=.025,settle=3)
        p['move_tip'](pos[0],speed=.012,settle=4)
        # Uniform distance stepping, including pressure changes. Slow enough to track tight turns.
        arc=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pos,axis=0),axis=1))]
        ss=np.linspace(0,arc[-1],int(np.ceil(arc[-1]/.0004))+1)
        route=np.column_stack([np.interp(ss,arc,pos[:,j]) for j in range(3)])
        for j in range(1,len(route)):
            vel=(route[j]-route[j-1])/.05
            target=route[j]+.07*vel
            q,ok,e=s.ik(target)
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,j,e))
            s.step(q)
        p['move_tip']([*pos[-1,:2],.035],speed=.018,settle=5)
        Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(f'/app/output/canvas_{i}.png')
        print('stroke',i,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
    p['move_tip']([-.02,0,.08],speed=.08,settle=10)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,out)
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
    np.savez('/app/output/realized.npz',**{str(i):st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes())})
    print('path_mm',sum(st['length_mm'] for st in s.strokes()),'strokes',len(s.strokes()),flush=True)
    score=s.score();print(json.dumps(score,indent=2),flush=True)
    Path('/app/output/score.json').write_text(json.dumps(score,indent=2))
    return s

if __name__=='__main__':generate(*sys.argv[1:])
